notes.title: New version available (1.0.6)
notes.content: Added ability to change the background of the app from predefined options!

notes.title: New version available (1.0.5)
notes.content:
- Heavily improved scrolling and loading performance
- Natural sorting of files (by name) as in Windows
- Fixed numerous smaller bugs

notes.title: New version available (1.0.4)
notes.content:
- Ability to run multiple instances at once
- View properties of file/folders with Windows default "properties" window
- Small bugs fixes

notes.title: New version available (1.0.3)
notes.content:
- Fixed issues in the gallery mode when zooming/rotating/panning
- Select all when clicking into the address bar
- Minor UI fixes 
- Improved logging

notes.title: New version available (1.0.2)
notes.content:
- Added Slideshow functionality when in gallery view
- Fixed some issues causing hanging of app when running on more than 100% of display scaling
- Fixed opening My Computer view
